title: Grogu's Meditation Session with Luke Skywalker
description: As Master Yoda told Luke Skywalker, those who follow the path of the Jedi must have the deepest commitment and the most serious minds. Since his meeting with Grogu aboard Moff Gideon's cruiser, Luke has done his best to instill these teachings into Grogu so that he may one day become a great Jedi. Part of this training is learning to quiet one's mind and hear the Force all around — wisdom passed down from Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn. As Luke and Grogu sit in the jungle near the new Jedi academy, they ponder all of these things together.
